name: Andrew Little
story: As the minister responsible for the Marine and Coastal Area (Takutai Moana) Act, Andrew Little welcomed the public launch of Kōrero Takutai on 11 December 2019. The government release describes a free spatial portal combining applications, coastal permits, Walking Access information, marae locations and other public data for the New Zealand coastline.
